name: Hero renders and navigation and CTA work
description: The GREASH homepage hero shows a big headline with a rotating word and an animated equalizer pip, and the Listen free CTA scrolls to the working audio player section.

planSteps.description: A large display headline is visible whose first line reads Stories that (or very close to it), with a highlighted word that cycles between HEAR IT, FEEL IT, LIVE IT and LOSE IT over time
A small animated equalizer bars indicator appears in the tagline above the headline, indicating a live audio station
Click the Listen free button in the top navigation bar
The page scrolls to the audio player section headed One tap and the room disappears, which shows a play/pause control
